gnis-historic-archive.geojson.caveats: FROZEN AUG 2021 GNIS ARCHIVE — NOT CURRENT GNIS. This file is drawn from the superseded pre-rebuild GNIS Archive Minnesota file (MN_Features_20210825.txt, 50,552 rows, 3,524 historical-flagged statewide) and must stay labeled as archive records. It is a SEPARATE file from site/data/gnis-historic.geojson, which is the verified-zero record from current GNIS (published 20261102; only 129 historical features in all of Minnesota, none inside HUC8 07010102). Do NOT fold archive rows into the current-GNIS file. Historical flag = '(historical)' name suffix. Classes filtered to Post Office, School, Church, Cemetery, Locale, Dam, Populated Place; only School/Church/Cemetery/Dam/Populated Place returned zero in-watershed — all 28 are Post Office (18) or Locale (10). Coordinates are archive GNIS points (DMS-second precision, ~30 m); location_precision is 'archive record' on every feature — positions are as GNIS recorded them, not field-verified. GAP — LOTHROP: 'Lathrop Post Office (historical)' (GNIS 2071373, Cass County, Longville quad) is in the Archive but its coordinates are Unknown (0, 0), so it is EXCLUDED here and cannot be plotted from GNIS alone. Lothrop is a documented logging boom town on Ten Mile Lake's Long Bay, platted 1895, post office from 22 Dec 1894, ghost town by ~1901 (Cass County Museum Clippings Apr 2010; MPCA/DNR 2010 Ten Mile Lake assessment); it needs a hand-placed point from Cass County Museum/DNR sources, not GNIS. NEAR-MISS (excluded, both clip methods agree): 'Akeley Railroad Station (historical)' (GNIS 2094018, Hubbard County, 47.0036111, -94.7305556) falls ~40-60 m outside the HUC8 boundary and is not included. OUT OF SCOPE (verified present in-watershed but outside the requested classes, not included): 2 historical Airports — Steiner Landing Strip (659364, Cass) and Morrill Landing Strip (659408, Hubbard). No burial/cultural-site point was found in this pull; THPO/Band review not triggered by this dataset.
gnis-historic-archive.geojson.query: Frozen Aug 2021 GNIS Archive Minnesota file (MN_Features_20210825.txt) parsed and spatially clipped to the HUC8 07010102 polygon (scripts/huc8-07010102-clip.geojson), then filtered to historical-flagged features ('(historical)' name suffix) in classes Post Office, School, Church, Cemetery, Locale, Dam, Populated Place, WITH coordinates (rows with Unknown / 0,0 coordinates dropped). Count independently recounted a second way (pure-Python ray-casting point-in-polygon, no shapely): identical 28, identical feature IDs. Spot-checked against raw archive rows: Brevik Post Office 2071437 (47.08306, -94.28833), Tobique Post Office 2071262 (47.11556, -94.03944), Laporte Locale 2093965 (47.2152778, -94.7541667) — all match.
